description: Add an attachment to a CarlNotes topic you own: the page at a public url, or pasted text with a title, saved as a plain-text file. Carl reads it in the background, and every brew after that scores findings with it. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to attach something to a topic, with phrases like attach this page, attach this to the topic, or save this text to the topic.

text.description: Text to attach, with a title, in place of a url.

title.description: The title of the pasted text.

topic_id.description: The topic's id. Optional on a topic-bound server, which already knows its topic.

url.description: A public page to read and attach.

name: add_topic_attachment
title: Add an attachment
